code: chain <- function(sequence) {   residues <- ifelse(strsplit(sequence, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]] == "G", "Gal", "Man")   paste0(paste(residues, collapse = "(b1-4)"), "(b1-") } panel <- list(   linkage = c("Gal(b1-3)GlcNAc(b1-", "Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-"),   branches = c("Gal(b1-3)[GlcNAc(b1-6)]GalNAc(a1-",                "Gal(b1-6)[GlcNAc(b1-3)]GalNAc(a1-"),   reducing_end = c("Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(a1-", "Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-"),   single_residue = c("Gal(b1-", "Man(b1-"),   chain_8 = vapply(c("GGGMGGGG", "GGGGMGGG"), chain, ""),   chain_20 = vapply(c("GGGGGGMGGGGGGGGGGGGG", "GGGGGGGMGGGGGGGGGGGG"), chain, "") ) distinguishes <- function(x, encode) {   values <- encode(x)   !identical(values[[1]], values[[2]]) } comparison <- data.frame(   case = names(panel),   motif_1_to_3 = vapply(panel, distinguishes, TRUE,     encode = function(x) fp_motif_count(x, motif_dict = "dynamic")),   circular_r2 = vapply(panel, distinguishes, TRUE,     encode = function(x) fp_circular_count(x)),   residue_pair_r1 = vapply(panel, distinguishes, TRUE,     encode = function(x) fp_residue_pair(x, mode = "count")) ) knitr::kable(comparison, row.names = FALSE)
